registered_before: any Adult fit (frozen in SCIENCE_LOCK); executable: lcr/select.py
rows: INNER_SELECTION only (attackers fitted on AUDIT_FIT); never assessment values

ordinary_eligibility.scope: EACH seed (0, 1, 2) and EACH task (income, occupation); no averaging across seeds; a candidate whose mean hides a failing seed does not qualify
rules: true-label log loss <= U log loss + 0.01 nats
accuracy gain over the OSF_DEFENSE_FIT-majority constant >= 0.8 x U's gain
exact decision preservation for U-derived releases
ordinary_eligibility.implementation: qpc.utility.gate_record(code, U anchor of the same seed, preserved)['eligible'] (inclusive)
ordinary_eligibility.applies_to: every candidate and comparator (codes, D1 decoders, continuous sources, references)

no_headroom_buffer: cbp's 0.006/0.0035 every-seed headroom rule is NOT used (prompt section 10). The explicit 0.005/0.003 budgets act during FITTING only; the unchanged assessment bounds decide whether confidence preservation is established

keys: mean over seeds of INNER pair AUC (lower first)
mean over seeds of summed true-label task log loss (lower first)
mean actual total token states (fewer first; continuous releases +infinity for ORDERING only, null in JSON)
ordering.tie_tolerance: keys 1 and 2: float64 seed mean (x_seed0 + x_seed1 + x_seed2)/3 in seed order, then Python round(x, 12); equal rounded values tie (values < 1e-12 apart may still fall either side of a rounding boundary); key 3 exact; key 4 lexicographic

guard.rule: local inner AUC (recipient 1 and 2) <= guard comparator's local inner AUC + 0.005, inclusive, for EACH recipient and seed
guard.shortfall: exactly 0.0 iff the guard holds; otherwise max over guards, seeds, recipients of (a - g - 0.005)/0.005; ranking only

T*.note: strongest eligible privacy-UNTRAINED release: new C-TASK, D0/D1 DIRECT-TASK and FINE-TASK, U continuous, CLASS-ONLY, F0. RAW-J beta 0.3 is privacy-trained and excluded

P*.candidates: every privacy-trained release: D0 privacy maps (24), D1 fixed-map privacy controls (24), weighted controls (24), constrained arms (5)
P*.note: P* may be a control; if it wins it is delivered as the useful method and the new constrained search is reported as adding no demonstrated benefit. P* candidates are the 77 code arms only (24 D0, 24 D1 fixed-map, 24 weighted, 5 constrained); the privacy-trained references RAW-J, FARE and LEACE are not P* candidates (cbp convention; on these inner rows they are ordinarily ineligible)

C*.candidates: incumbent/baseline private releases: D0 and D1 fixed-map privacy maps and weighted controls (72); NO constrained arm

C_pair*.candidates: every scored candidate except U|K-JOINT-PAIR|i8o64|D1 (incl. constrained LOCAL, both sequential arms, JOINT-SINGLE and every incumbent control, sources and references)

Q.eligibility: ordinary (prerequisite); otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE with P34-P37 DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY

privacy_trained_labels: fixed-map D1 privacy releases remain privacy-trained controls (their maps were privacy-trained); the D1 decoder itself uses no SEX
global_configuration: one configuration fixed across all three seeds; no per-seed lambda or family; no assessment-based choice

nominee_roles: INVALID_NOMINEE (technical failure; or an eligible nominee blocked only by a missing guard comparator)

fallback_ordering.rule: when no candidate is nominable: fit-feasible candidates first (an infeasible constrained fit ranks last, review R-5), then smallest ordinary shortfall, then smallest guard shortfall, then the ordering keys; DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
fallback_ordering.missing_guard: a required guard role without a valid nominee: INVALID (MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR) if any candidate is eligible; otherwise NO_ELIGIBLE with fallback ranked on the ordinary shortfall and ordering keys only and fallback_rank_status INVALID_MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR (never a zero guard field)
fallback_ordering.reason_codes: FIT_OR_ADMISSION_FAILURE, DECISION_PRESERVATION_FAILURE, NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC (technical; joined with '+'); ORDINARY_UTILITY_FAILURE, LOCAL_GUARD_FAILURE (selection); MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR; CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE (selection)

aliases: exact release aliases = identical deployed tokens AND released probabilities on all three seeds (sha256 of tok1, q1, tok2, q2); a D1 fixed-map release shares tokens with its D0 map but is NOT an alias. The label names the simplest family and construction among P*'s exact aliases (LABEL_TRUTH_TABLE.json winning_family_naming); partial aliases and the ID tie-break are disclosed
prespecified_diagnostics: best_d1_fixed_privacy: the strongest ordinarily eligible D1 fixed-map privacy control with the T* guard (or its fallback) and its paired D0 release
best_weighted_privacy: the strongest ordinarily eligible weighted control with the T* guard (or its fallback)

display.training: rows carry a display field 'training': privacy-trained code / privacy-untrained code / privacy-trained reference (RAW-J, FARE, LEACE) / privacy-untrained reference (SRC|U, F0); display only, never a role input

constrained_fit_feasibility: a constrained unit (K-*) is eligible only if its fit record has status FEASIBLE and deployed.feasible True on EVERY seed; an infeasible constrained fit (saved by lcr.mapper as a descriptive copy) is never a nominee for P*, N* or J*, is excluded from the C_pair* comparator pool, and gives the role reason CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE ('infeasible under this registered decoder') when no feasible candidate exists; it may still be the descriptive fallback (flag fit_feasible false). Consequence (registered): K arms have no restoration phase, so if C-TASK violates a fitting budget on a seed, K-LOCAL (whose only start is C-TASK) is infeasible on that seed by construction
